ns2:course.label: Adult Public Services
ns2:course.description: The literature, history, and problems of providing library service to the general adult user; investigation of user characteristics and needs, and the effectiveness of various types of adult services.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to CAS:Lib & Info Sci Online-UIUC or MS:Library & Infor Sci -UIUC.
